observed_result.summary: Observed on fixture ca1 with a live ControlMaster (1 Accepted line at master start): the verification command (ControlMaster=no, ControlPath=none, explicit identity/certificate/agent, publickey only, BatchMode) rc 0 with exactly 1 new Accepted line carrying the expected ID and 1 new TCP connection. Negative control through the control socket: rc 0 with 0 new Accepted lines and 0 new connections, so reuse is not verification. Master closed with -O exit (process gone, socket removed). Verdict pass.
